items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That must be the one that Jolly Roll played against. [INTERVIEWEE] He might have been.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never called it Lovey Austin, see that's wrong. That's wrong too? Yeah, that's wrong. I had George Reynolds on the piano. Where was he from? St. Louis.
That must be the one that Jolly Roll played against.
